description: Vacuum Panic! — a daily cat dash for Reddit. Dodge the robot vacuums, catch fish treats and yarn balls, survive 60 seconds. Same puzzle for everyone, every day.
name: vacuum-panic

scripts.build: npm run build:client && npm run build:server
scripts.test: npm run test:types && npm run test:unit && npm run build
scripts.watch: sh -c 'trap "kill 0" exit; npm run build:client -- --watch=forever& npm run build:server -- --watch=forever& wait' --
